title: The Judaica Press complete Tanach with Rashi, translated by A. J. Rosenberg
text: with stringed instrument and flute Heb. במנים ועגב. They are kinds of musical instruments.
with resounding cymbals Heb. בצלצלי שמע, cymbals that let a sound be heard.
שָׁמַע is a noun, like שֶׁמַע, with a “segol,” but because of the “ethnactha” [which denotes a pause], it is vowelized with a long “kamatz,” and therefore, its accent is above, under the “shin.”
